rules: Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use defined fonts.
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
No pure black or white for backgrounds. Always tint with warm hues.
Use Terracotta as primary CTA color sparingly. Use WhatsApp green specifically for send/share actions.
Use Accent Gold for elegant wedding template highlights.

layouts.marketing: The Bento Grid Protocol - Tetris Grid. Asymmetric. Generous padding (p-12 to p-24).
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid for RSVP analytics. Strict hierarchy. Cardless or 1px subtle borders (border-border).
layouts.editor: Two-column split: Left side form controls (Shadcn forms/tabs), Right side sticky mobile preview (iframe-style phone mockup).
layouts.guest_facing: Mobile-first, full vertical scrolling with scroll-triggered animations. Background music player fixed at bottom right.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized with Organic earthy palette for the Dashboard. Custom DOM/HTML for Marketing and Public Invitation pages.

visual_enhancers: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for landing page sticky headers: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40 border-b.
Subtle grain/noise overlays for the wedding templates to feel like physical textured paper.
Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations on landing page and guest invitation pages.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.
Add data-testid to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='create-event-btn').
Hover state must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.

rules: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.
Hero image overlays max bg-black/30 for dark, bg-white/30 for light.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard SaaS dashboard using Shadcn customized with 'Organic & Earthy' theme. Ensure 1px subtle borders (border-border), avoid overly soft card shadows.
For the Landing page, implement a premium asymmetric Bento grid and Crystal Glassmorphism header. Use Framer Motion for scroll effects.
The Event Editor should feature a left-side form (accordion/tabs) and a right-side sticky Mobile Preview iframe-like container.
Implement an elegant RSVP dashboard utilizing Recharts for attendance metrics (pie/bar).
Use data-testid on every interactive UI component.
Create 3 distinct template views for the guest-facing pages using the provided typography and floral/wedding background images.
Write code for .js (.jsx) files rather than .tsx, ensuring standard React structural conventions.
Make sure the WhatsApp delivery UI is mocked cleanly but prominently.
Implement a mock Xendit payment flow before the 'publish' status is granted.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
